application.interpretation: The theorem controls a regular local branch whose full gauge-fixed linearization is an isomorphism. A C3 branch with one critical collective is outside this theorem and instead needs a Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction with a uniform gap on the complement. A first-order crossing needs an exhaustive uniform free-energy gap. Missing hypotheses leave the physical question open.

analytic_branch_theorem.global_caveat: A first-order crossing with a distinct branch is excluded only after a separate exhaustive uniform free-energy gap to all competitors is proved.
analytic_branch_theorem.local_statement: For an analytic gauge-fixed boundary-value map between fixed Banach spaces, constant Dirac rank and a boundedly invertible full linearized operator let the analytic implicit-function theorem give a unique local analytic stationary branch and analytic on-shell Dirichlet-to-Neumann map.
analytic_branch_theorem.scope: A failed hypothesis opens a calculation; it is not evidence for a transition and not a no-go against one.
ways_a_transition_can_remain_open: a retained physical mode becomes gapless
two stable branches cross in free energy
a healthy threshold independently derives a nonanalytic microscopic functional below its certified cutoff

campaign_step_projection.projection_scope: Partial step projection only; this artifact is not a standalone holo.mechanism-campaign.v1 document.
campaign_step_projection.status_semantics: ready means C2 unlocked the ladder step; it does not override the INPUT_INCOMPLETE/BLOCKED_C3 diagnostic.

candidate_spectral_adjudication.interpretation: Completing R9 means performing the candidate calculation; it does not predetermine an isomorphism, a critical kernel, a complement gap, a free-energy gap or cutoff separation.

decision.next_action: Freeze and derive the missing inputs in one total action, then solve all branches and evaluate the predeclared kill criteria without changing boundary jets or source conventions.
decision.reason: The existing certificates close important background, ADM, bending, BPS and selector precursors, but they do not freeze the complete boundary/junction, nonlinear constraint and matter-source problem.

evidence_boundary: This certificate composes existing theory-only results and proves that the C3 calculation is not yet well posed. It neither rejects geometric phase transitions nor claims a force, critical exponent, lensing response or physical completion.

functional_analytic_adjudication.interpretation: Frozen actions and completed equations are prerequisites only. They do not by themselves certify analyticity on chosen function spaces, Fredholm well-posedness, constant Dirac rank or an algebraic auxiliary Jacobian.

kill_criteria.kill_if: The full gauge-fixed boundary-value linearization is an isomorphism, an exhaustive uniform free-energy gap selects this branch, and its Dirichlet-to-Neumann map stays regular and analytic instead of developing a protected critical collective.
kill_criteria.test: Apply the analytic branch theorem to the fully reduced source-zero solution.

kill_criteria.kill_if: Criticality at zero source requires tuning any unprotected boundary jet, brane scale or Wilson coefficient.
kill_criteria.test: Derive the normal form and count independent relevant coefficients before comparison with the target.

kill_criteria.kill_if: A negative-norm or negative-energy physical mode, ill-posed characteristic, or vanishing tensor Planck coefficient occurs.
kill_criteria.test: Compute the gauge-reduced Hessian, kinetic residues and full principal symbol on the selected branch.

kill_criteria.kill_if: The nonanalyticity is a gauge kernel or unsolved lapse/shift constraint, or the Dirac rank changes anywhere on the candidate branch.
kill_criteria.test: Track the Dirac rank and physical mode count through the candidate transition.

kill_criteria.kill_if: The selected branch fails any background equation, junction condition or source conservation identity.
kill_criteria.test: Vary the same total action and evaluate bulk equations, scalar/Israel junctions and conserved matter Ward identities.

kill_criteria.kill_if: The leading relation is nonlocal or its supposedly local coefficient depends on source geometry.
kill_criteria.test: Extract the local Dirichlet-to-Neumann normal form for two frozen conserved source geometries.

kill_criteria.kill_if: The physical q^2Y vertex or stable g6 coefficient is absent after all inputs are complete.
kill_criteria.test: Project the complete constrained action through q^2Y and q^6 on the selected canonical mode.

kill_criteria.kill_if: Any physical mode other than the single selected collective becomes gapless, a tower accumulates at zero, or the transition occurs at or above the EFT cutoff.
kill_criteria.test: Bound the full non-collective spectrum uniformly and compare every transition scale with the independently derived EFT cutoff.

R10_two_conserved_source_geometries_froz.consequence_if_missing: Locality and geometry-independent normal-form coefficients cannot be tested.
R10_two_conserved_source_geometries_froz.description: Two non-equivalent conserved source geometries are frozen before solving the nonlinear map.

R1_bulk_action_and_background_frozen.consequence_if_missing: No nonlinear C3 variational problem can be posed.
R1_bulk_action_and_background_frozen.description: A concrete Einstein--dilaton bulk action and background are available on the certified interval.

R2_complete_boundary_action_and_jets_fro.consequence_if_missing: Boundary normal forms and any apparent critical point remain selectable inputs.
R2_complete_boundary_action_and_jets_fro.description: All brane potentials and boundary jets required by the nonlinear order are fixed before the C3 scan.

R3_eh_ghy_boundary_variation_complete.consequence_if_missing: The endpoint action and junction operator are not derived in the same variables.
R3_eh_ghy_boundary_variation_complete.description: The complete EH+GHY+brane variation is recovered on nonzero endpoint profiles.

R4_nonlinear_junctions_with_bending_comp.consequence_if_missing: A candidate branch cannot be checked against the actual endpoint equations.
R4_nonlinear_junctions_with_bending_comp.description: Scalar and Israel junctions including bending are derived from the frozen total action through the required order.

R5_nonlinear_lapse_shift_and_dirac_syste.consequence_if_missing: A gauge kernel or constraint-rank change could be mistaken for a physical transition.
R5_nonlinear_lapse_shift_and_dirac_syste.description: Nonlinear lapse and shift constraints, gauge quotient and Dirac rank are solved on every candidate branch.

R6_matter_action_localization_and_source.consequence_if_missing: The source family and its coupling to the geometric branch remain undefined.
R6_matter_action_localization_and_source.description: The conserved matter action, radial localization, Y convention and absolute normalization are frozen.

R7_physical_q2y_and_g6_vertices_derived.consequence_if_missing: The proposed transition is not connected to the required local constitutive vertex.
R7_physical_q2y_and_g6_vertices_derived.description: The same constrained reduction derives the physical q^2Y vertex and stable g6 coefficient.

R8_branch_family_and_selection_rule_froz.consequence_if_missing: Neither codimension nor free-energy competition can be evaluated.
R8_branch_family_and_selection_rule_froz.description: All competing branches and a target-independent rule selecting the physical branch are specified.

R9_candidate_spectrum_symbol_and_free_en.consequence_if_missing: The baseline positive S2 spectrum cannot be reused as the gap of an unspecified critical branch.
R9_candidate_spectrum_symbol_and_free_en.description: Each nonlinear branch has a physical fluctuation spectrum, principal symbol and free-energy comparison.
